latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Subtitle — Generate and Burn In Captions:

- Instantly generate and add AI subtitles to videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Automatic cloud session/token setup for easy first-run experience (no manual API keys required).
- Simple, intent-driven commands: just upload videos and describe what you want; captions are returned in 30–60 seconds.
- Export captioned videos in high-quality 1080p MP4 format.
- Streamlined error handling and transparent, free usage with 100 credits provided (no subscription required).
- Supports batch, quick-edit, and iterative workflows for content creators.
